_comment: Expected PP-406 fill for case.overflow.json — slot-overflow scenario. The 6 form slots are saturated; rows 7-8 go on an addendum sheet (separate document, not in this fill).
_overflow_resolution:
Two valid pipelines:
1. (current) Fill the 6 slots with the 6 highest-value entities; flag the 2 remainders for addendum; gross_value_real_property = sum of all 8 ($1,155,500) with addendum reference in submission.
2. (formula-strict) Fill 6 slots; gross_value_real_property = sum_slot of 6 ($1,105,000); add separate adjustment row 'addendum total $50,500' — but PP-406 has no such field. This is why approach #1 is the practical answer.
_packing_strategy: Pack the 6 form slots with the 6 HIGHEST-value real properties (primary, duplex, lake camp, vacant lot, storage barn, woodlot). The two lower-value overflow entries (1/4 cottage interest, marina slip) go on the addendum.
